outcome: Deliver the complete Tasktra 1.0 generic software-development orchestration baseline.
motivation: Provide a Codex-first, local-first, reusable orchestration system that preserves specialist depth, enables approved long-running work, remains usable without online integrations, and optimizes token use without sacrificing required quality or validation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All roadmap stage gates have completion evidence
The 1.0 definition in docs/SPECIFICATION.md is satisfied
Independent acceptance and semantic reviews have no unresolved blockers

quality_requirements: Meet every documented stage acceptance criterion before closing that stage.
Use focused deterministic checks before model review and preserve evidence once.
Keep default agent context bounded while retaining specialist roles for material work.
Require independent semantic and acceptance review for each stage boundary.
Keep optional online capabilities from blocking local work.
stop_conditions: Required work would modify data outside the Tasktra repository.
Required work would create a remote, deployment, merge, destructive, or repository-history effect.
An explicit user stop or emergency stop is active.
escalation_conditions: A material product choice is not covered by the confirmed specification.
A required action exceeds the recorded authority or effect classes.
Independent reviewers find a blocker that cannot be resolved locally.
A stage requires credentials, external coordination, or a consequential remote action.
